summary: Comprehensive testing of Arcade site (4 games + leaderboard). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases passed (POST/GET scores, validation, sorting, limit, stats). Frontend: All 4 game cards render on home; navigation works; 2048 arrow-key movement + reset works; Snake start + arrow-key play + game-over overlay works; Memory card flip + moves counter works; TicTacToe cell click places X (SVG icon) + AI responds with O; Full end-to-end score submission flow verified via Memory: game completion opens NicknameDialog, submission calls POST /api/scores, success toast shows, leaderboard reloads and highlights the new row (TEST_MemBot 944).
critical_code_review_comments: SnakeGame.jsx (line 92): onGameOver invoked without a game-over UI dialog directly; nickname dialog only triggers when score>0. Behaviour correct but users dying at score 0 do not get any prompt, which is fine.

TicTacToe.jsx: minimax AI is unbeatable (X plays first, optimal AI => at best a draw). Consequently the streak-based leaderboard is practically unreachable. Consider weakening the AI to make the leaderboard reachable, or triggering onGameOver on draw with a small consolation score.
Game2048.jsx line 122 hook dep list intentionally omits deps; acceptable but relies on eslint-disable.
server.py: /api/scores POST returns 200 (via response_model); RESTful convention would be 201 Created — not a bug but worth noting.
No pagination or dedup on GET /api/scores/{game}; a single nickname can occupy multiple leaderboard slots.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests seeded TEST_-prefixed scores for each game. Frontend E2E created TEST_MemBot score 944 in 'memory' leaderboard. Not cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend routes: POST /api/scores (returns 200), GET /api/scores/{game}?limit=N, GET /api/stats. VALID_GAMES = tic-tac-toe|snake|memory|2048. Slug for tic-tac-toe route is /joc/x-si-0 (see gamesConfig.js). NicknameDialog appears only when onGameOver called with score>0. TicTacToe AI is unbeatable so streak stays 0 → dialog never opens from TTT in normal play. Memory game path is the easiest for end-to-end dialog testing (solve all pairs). All data-testids are wired correctly.
